notes.title: Hotfix 1.12a - Feb 23, 2019
notes.content:
Hello all,

Here are the patch notes for hotfix 1.12a:

[list]
[*] The game window will no longer annoyingly re-center itself on your monitor every time you return to the main menu (apologies to streamers who wrestled with this). The window will still center itself when you change the window scale or toggle fullscreen on/off.
[*] Fixed a visual bug in "HACK!" where an invisible asset became... less invisible.
[/list]
In addition, you can always contact us if you encounter bugs or have any feedback: GameSoupLP (at) gmail dot com.

notes.title: Patch 1.12 - "Rename!" is now live!
notes.content:
Hello all!

Here are the patch notes for today's update to version 1.12. You can verify your game version by hitting F12 on the title screen.

Thank you for the fantastic launch week - Joe and I are beyond humbled at the reception for Game Soup, and we hope you've enjoyed your time with the game so far!

Sincerely, Joe and Ed

[h1][b]Update Version 1.12 Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[u][b]GAMEPLAY/BALANCE:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] The enter key can now be used on the main menu to "confirm" options just like the space bar/mouse click.
[*] Balanced (reduced) audio volume of title theme relative to other music. [*] Balanced (reduced) audio volume of credits music relative to other music.
[*] "Strike!" - Renamed to "Intervene!" to better convey the win condition.
[*] "Defend!" - Renamed to "Spit!" to better convey the win condition.
[*] "Marry!" - Increased the hitbox for the ring finger.
[*] "Marry!" - Reduced horizontal speed of the ring.
[*] "Go fast!" - Added new configurations of platforms.
[*] "Evade!" - The "crosses" configuration now spawns columns farther away from the player.
[*] "Block!" - Slightly reduced the player's hitbox. This is a buff.
[/list]

[u][b]OPTIONS:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] You can now toggle vertical sync on and off in the options menu.
[*] You can now choose from 4 levels of anti-aliasing: 0 (default), 2x, 4x, and 8x. 
[*][b] NOTE: [/b]Unless you are having specific graphical issues, [b]you may want to leave these options turned OFF[/b]--they could cost you some performance for little to no graphical benefit, depending on your specs. Additionally, if you encounter a game crash when attempting to change or after changing these values in the options menu, you can manually reset your AA and V-sync levels to "0" in the game's config file in this default path:
C:\<user>\appdata\local\Game_Soup\data.dat. You can open "data.dat" by changing the file extension to ".ini" then double-clicking or by using a program like Notepad++ to open the file directly.
[/list]

[u][b]
BUG FIXES:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare crash in "Dig!" that we never encountered in all our hours of testing. Thanks Neil!
[*] Fixed a bug where you could get stuck underneath platforms in "Smash!" when playing at very high speeds.
[/list]
